step.title: Greedy wrap(text, width) with tests

proof.text: `node --test` passes; `wrap()` breaks lines at the last space that fits

step.doneWhen: `node --test` passes; `wrap()` breaks lines at the last space that fits

decisions: D1 (greedy-breaking): greedy line breaking over optimal, because it is what fmt and fold do and the simplest thing that works
D2 (returns-lines): `wrap(text, width)` is a named export that returns an array of lines, because a caller joins them as it likes
constraints: C1 (no-runtime-deps): no runtime dependencies, because the demo must run anywhere Node runs
C2 (node-test-only): tests use node:test and node:assert only, because the point is the loop, not the test framework
